articles.title: Hong Kong fire survivors rebuild lives from ashes
articles.titleCn: 香港火灾幸存者从废墟中重建生活
articles.summary: Lau is counting the days to June 30, a deadline that offers survivors of Hong Kong's Wang Fuk Court fire tragedy a potential new start in life after about seven months in the wilderness.
articles.summaryCn: 香港旺角富苑火灾幸存者在政府收购计划和社会支持下，逐步从灾难中恢复并重建家园。

paragraphs.en: Lau is counting the days to June 30, a {{0}} that offers {{1}} of Hong Kong's Wang Fuk Court fire tragedy a potential new start in life after about seven months in the wilderness. It's the first {{2}} date for affected apartment owners to take up the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region government's buyout offer for their burned-out apartments. An acceptance letter will {{3}} an owner to take part in the "first-round selection" for a new home under a special sales program. A {{4}} will determine who chooses first. "The draw could lead us anywhere," Lau said.
paragraphs.cn: 刘女士正在倒计时到6月30日，这个截止日期为香港旺角富苑火灾的幸存者提供了在荒野中度过约七个月后潜在的新生活起点。这是受影响的公寓业主接受香港特别行政区政府对其烧毁公寓收购要约的第一个指定日期。接受信将使业主有权参加特别销售计划下的“首轮选择”新房。抽签将决定谁先选择。“抽签可能把我们带到任何地方，”刘女士说。

paragraphs.en:
"Still, a place to call my own is, in the end, better than any rented room."
Lau had just completed {{5}} of her home on the 16th floor of Wang Sun House, one of eight towers on the estate, when the blaze {{6}} Wang Fuk Court on Nov 26. Within hours, seven buildings were ablaze. The {{7}} raged for 43 hours, and 168 people lost their lives in the city's deadliest fire in nearly eight decades. The apartment complex in Tai Po district, near Hong Kong's boundary with the Chinese mainland, was home to more than 4,600 residents. Lau and her family are among almost 2,000 {{8}} households piecing their lives back together after the disaster.
paragraphs.cn: “尽管如此，一个属于自己的地方终究比任何租来的房间好。”刘女士刚刚完成她在旺新大厦16楼的家装修，这是该小区八座塔楼之一，11月26日大火吞噬了旺角富苑。几小时内，七座建筑起火。大火肆虐了43小时，168人在这场近八十年来香港最致命的火灾中丧生。位于大埔区、靠近香港与中国大陆边界的小区曾是超过4600名居民的家。刘女士和她的家人是近2000个流离失所的家庭之一，他们在灾难后努力重建生活。

paragraphs.en: Lau, her husband, and two sons moved three times in the month following the fire. Despite being provided a {{9}} shelter by the HKSAR government, they accepted a friend's offer to live in a beauty salon, she said. However, Lau's husband was too {{10}} to linger in the salon during the day as customers streamed in. He went to a nearby park and sat there from "sunrise to sunset", she said. "I felt so sorry for him and found us somewhere else to live as fast as I could," Lau said.
paragraphs.cn: 刘女士、她的丈夫和两个儿子在火灾后的一个月内搬了三次家。尽管香港特区政府提供了临时庇护所，但他们接受了朋友的建议，住在一家美容院里，她说。然而，刘女士的丈夫白天因顾客络绎不绝而尴尬地待在美容院。他去附近的公园，从“日出坐到日落”，她说。“我为他感到非常难过，尽快找到了其他地方住，”刘女士说。

paragraphs.en:
Resettlement top concern
Some of the surviving Wang Fuk Court residents believe the path ahead is clear in outline, if not in details. The HKSAR government has offered Wang Fuk Court apartment owners {{12}} prices of HK $8,000 ($1,020) or HK $10,500 per square foot, either as cash or a "flat-for-flat" exchange voucher. Wang Chi House, the sole tower spared from the blaze, will be included only if at least 75 percent of owners agree to the buyout plan by June 30. The total cost of acquiring all eight blocks is estimated at HK $7.8 billion, involving HK $5 billion in public funds and HK $2.8 billion from a support fund established by the government. A number of residents China Daily spoke to described {{11}} as "{{13}}" and "{{14}}".
paragraphs.cn: 重新安置是首要关切。一些幸存的旺角富苑居民认为，即使细节不明确，前方的道路大体清晰。香港特区政府已向旺角富苑公寓业主提供每平方英尺8000港元（1020美元）或10500港元的收购价格，可以是现金或“房换房”交换券。唯一幸免于火灾的旺智大厦只有在6月30日前至少75%的业主同意收购计划时才会被纳入。收购所有八座楼的总成本估计为78亿港元，包括50亿港元的公共资金和28亿港元来自政府设立的支援基金。《中国日报》采访的一些居民将重新安置描述为“迷宫般的”和“令人迷失方向的”。

paragraphs.en: Their questions mainly related to the size of the new residences to be offered and their locations. Joe Wong, whose family of five lived in Wang Tai House in the estate, said he is now a "{{15}} man". Part of his daily routine used to be walking his daughter to her primary school in Tai Po. Now, he lies awake at night wondering whether the flats on offer will match what they once had, with a {{16}} living space, and transport and medical care within reach. Wong, who said his concerns are shared by many other former residents, also hopes for a sense of community and an established school network at his new home.
paragraphs.cn: 他们的问题主要涉及将提供的新住宅的大小和位置。乔·王，他的五口之家曾住在小区内的旺泰大厦，他说他现在是一个“流离失所的人”。他过去日常的一部分是送女儿去大埔的小学。现在，他彻夜难眠，担心提供的公寓是否能与他们曾经拥有的相匹配，具有可比的生活空间，以及交通和医疗便利。王说，他的担忧与许多其他前居民共享，他还希望在新家有一个社区感和完善的学校网络。

paragraphs.en: Under the official special sale program, 10 developments are in the {{17}}. The earliest project could welcome residents by the end of 2026. The last developments will not be ready until 2030 or 2031. Among the projects is a two-phase new development in Tai Po featuring 1,500 units. The earliest move-in date is expected to be in 2029 under the most optimistic forecast.
paragraphs.cn: 根据官方的特别销售计划，有10个开发项目正在进行中。最早的项目可能在2026年底迎接居民。最后的开发项目要到2030年或2031年才能准备好。其中项目之一是大埔的一个两期新开发项目，提供1500个单位。在最乐观的预测下，最早的入住日期预计在2029年。

paragraphs.en:
The government has ruled out rebuilding on the Wang Fuk Court site citing technical {{18}} and a drawn-out timeline. But some residents remain hopeful that the authorities might reconsider rebuilding the estate on the old site or nearby. Generous donors, inquiry
On Nov 27, the day after the fire, a dedicated assistance fund — the Support Fund for Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po — was launched with HK $300 million in start-up capital from the HKSAR government. Within a day, public {{19}} from across the country added another HK $500 million. By the third day, the total had reached HK $1.2 billion.
paragraphs.cn: 政府已排除在旺角富苑原址重建的可能性，理由是技术限制和漫长的时间表。但一些居民仍希望当局可能重新考虑在原址或附近重建小区。慷慨的捐赠与调查。11月27日，火灾后的第二天，一个专门的援助基金——大埔旺角富苑支援基金——启动，初始资金来自香港特区政府的3亿港元。一天之内，来自全国各地的公众捐款又增加了5亿港元。到第三天，总额已达到12亿港元。

paragraphs.en: The donations kept rolling in and by late February the fund had hit HK $4.7 billion. About 98 percent of the public donations were in amounts of HK $10,000 or less, authorities disclosed earlier this year, adding they were likely from "ordinary people". Large contributions of over HK $1 million from institutions and companies numbered more than 700. Some of the money has already been used for 13 support programs, including condolence and funeral payments for the families of the deceased, according to the fund's official website. Funds have also been allocated for living allowances, rent and relocation subsidies for displaced residents, along with grants and subsidies for affected students, workers, and foreign domestic helpers.
paragraphs.cn: 捐款持续涌入，到2月底，基金已达到47亿港元。当局今年早些时候透露，约98%的公众捐款金额为1万港元或更少，并补充说这些可能来自“普通人”。来自机构和公司超过100万港元的大额捐款超过700笔。根据基金官方网站，部分资金已用于13个支援项目，包括为死者家属提供的慰问和丧葬费用。资金也已分配用于流离失所居民的生活津贴、租金和搬迁补贴，以及受影响的学生、工人和外籍家庭佣工的补助和津贴。

paragraphs.en: A Chinese New Year goodwill token was also offered. Multiple private charities have also been distributing funds raised in the fire's aftermath. In March, the Hong Kong Red Cross reported over HK $530 million in donations. The Red Cross said the donations would provide urgent relief funds as well as financial and psychological support for Wang Fuk Court fire victims. They will also help fund a five-year community program, providing training in disaster preparedness and first aid.
paragraphs.cn: 还提供了春节慰问金。多个私人慈善机构也在分发火灾后筹集的资金。3月，香港红十字会报告超过5.3亿港元的捐款。红十字会表示，这些捐款将为旺角富苑火灾受害者提供紧急救济资金以及财务和心理支持。它们还将资助一个为期五年的社区项目，提供备灾和急救培训。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, an independent commission was formed in December, tasked with uncovering the root structural flaws leading to the blaze and its exceptionally rapid spread. The committee held 24 public hearings from March to early May. Three more are scheduled for Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. Evidence at the hearings has indicated a litany of suspected human factors in the blaze. The list includes: the estate's main fire alarm being deactivated during the fire; flammable scaffolding mesh and foam panels being used for renovation work; and the maintenance project's consultant and contractors likely rigging the tendering process.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，一个独立委员会于12月成立，负责查明导致火灾及其异常迅速蔓延的根本结构缺陷。委员会从3月到5月初举行了24次公开听证会。另有三次安排在周一、周三和周四。听证会上的证据表明，火灾中存在一系列涉嫌人为因素。清单包括：小区主火警在火灾期间被关闭；用于装修工作的易燃脚手架网和泡沫板；以及维护项目的顾问和承包商可能操纵招标过程。

paragraphs.en:
Oversight of the actual on-site maintenance work barely existed, the inquiry also heard. The committee has nine months to determine the fire's cause and recommend systemic reforms. Local authorities have already floated a raft of legislative amendments and additional fire safety-related rules to overhaul building maintenance and fire-service regulation. Seven individuals and two companies — the contractor and engineering consultant involved in the estate's renovation work — appeared in court on June 10 to face 25 offenses including conspiracy to defraud, money laundering, attempting to pervert the course of justice, and tax evasion. Charred memories
Displaced families from the estate's seven fire-ravaged blocks were allowed to return to the site for the first time on April 20 to retrieve what remained of their possessions.
paragraphs.cn: 调查还得知，对实际现场维护工作的监督几乎不存在。委员会有九个月的时间来确定火灾原因并建议系统性改革。地方当局已提出一系列立法修正案和额外的消防安全相关规则，以彻底改革建筑维护和消防服务监管。七名个人和两家公司——参与小区装修工程的承包商和工程顾问——于6月10日出庭，面临25项指控，包括串谋诈骗、洗钱、试图妨碍司法公正和逃税。烧焦的记忆。来自小区七座被火灾摧毁的楼的流离失所家庭于4月20日首次获准返回现场，取回他们剩余的财物。

paragraphs.en: For many, it was also an opportunity to say goodbye to the place they once called home. Among them were Gabby and Antonio, a married couple from Wang Sun House in their 40s. Inside their apartment, the plaster on the smoke-stained walls hung like ragged sheets. The door was burned through, and building debris littered the floor. "We braced ourselves beforehand," they said.
paragraphs.cn: 对许多人来说，这也是一个向他们曾经称之为家的地方告别的机会。其中包括加比和安东尼奥，一对来自旺新大厦的40多岁已婚夫妇。在他们的公寓内，烟熏墙壁上的灰泥像破布一样挂着。门被烧穿，建筑碎片散落在地板上。“我们事先做好了心理准备，”他们说。

paragraphs.en:
"The stair climb, and our flat's condition, were about what we imagined."
However, there was some joy amid the ruins. Antonio retrieved one of their wedding rings from their bedroom using a metal detector. Gabby also pulled some of her old drawings from the debris. On a yellowed sheet of paper with charred edges was written the word "Family". She plans to have the page framed and displayed once they settle into a new home.
paragraphs.cn: “爬楼梯和我们公寓的状况，大致如我们所想象。”然而，废墟中也有一些喜悦。安东尼奥用金属探测器从卧室里找到了他们的结婚戒指之一。加比还从碎片中拉出了一些她旧画作。在一张边缘烧焦的发黄纸上写着“家庭”一词。她计划在搬进新家后把这页纸装裱起来展示。

paragraphs.en: At Wang Sun House, Lau was among the first former residents to go upstairs. Unfortunately, she said gold ingots she had in her apartment were missing. She reported the suspected theft to the police. By May 30, a total of 142 such reports had been made by Wang Fuk Court residents, with 16 cases remaining open, Hong Kong authorities said. A local official reported that 1,674 of the 1,736 affected households in the seven fire-hit buildings — 6,265 people, including former residents, friends and helpers — had gone upstairs during the visiting period from April 20 to May 4.
paragraphs.cn: 在旺新大厦，刘女士是首批上楼的前居民之一。不幸的是，她说她公寓里的金条不见了。她向警方报告了疑似盗窃。截至5月30日，旺角富苑居民共提交了142份此类报告，其中16起案件仍在调查中，香港当局表示。一名地方官员报告说，在七座火灾建筑中的1736户受影响家庭中，有1674户——包括前居民、朋友和帮手在内的6265人——在4月20日至5月4日的参观期间上了楼。

paragraphs.en:
Around 50 opted out after viewing photos of their flats. Fewer than 10 required separate arrangements, the official reported. Residents of Wang Chi House — the sole block untouched by the blaze — had made two return trips by May 17. A second round of visits to the seven fire-hit buildings ran from May 21 to 29. 'Not alone'
Months on from the inferno, Lau still gets goose bumps just talking about it.
paragraphs.cn: 约50人在查看公寓照片后选择退出。该官员报告说，不到10人需要单独安排。旺智大厦——唯一未受火灾影响的楼——的居民截至5月17日已进行了两次返回。对七座火灾建筑的第二次参观于5月21日至29日进行。“并不孤单”。火灾过去数月后，刘女士一谈起这件事仍然起鸡皮疙瘩。

paragraphs.en: One of her neighbors lost a child in the fire, and a playmate of Lau's child lost her mother. George Cheung Chi-lim, aged in his 70s, and his wife suffered physical injuries and have been diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder. Joe Wong said his seven-year-old is "a different person" now — "touchier and easily angered". Despite the negative psychological impacts of the tragedy, the survivors China Daily spoke to all agreed they were not facing their problems alone. Lau said she still sees her old neighbors.
paragraphs.cn: 她的一个邻居在火灾中失去了一个孩子，刘女士孩子的一个玩伴失去了母亲。70多岁的乔治·张智林和他的妻子身体受伤，并被诊断出患有创伤后应激障碍。乔·王说他七岁的孩子现在“变了一个人”——“更敏感，容易生气”。尽管悲剧带来了负面心理影响，《中国日报》采访的幸存者都同意他们并非独自面对问题。刘女士说她仍然见到她的老邻居。

paragraphs.en:
"We had one good cry together," she said. "Now we silently agree not to pick the wounds anymore."
Instead, they share memories of leaning on one another amid the calamity: water poured from upstairs windows down onto the flames, and Styrofoam window seals carried inside to stop the possibility of any molten drops falling on the floors below. Cheung, a resident of Wang Fuk Court for over four decades, testified before the independent commission in March. He spoke of climbing onto a windowsill and throwing water on the flames. He said he and his wife took in an elderly neighbor who could not flee.
paragraphs.cn: “我们一起大哭了一场，”她说。“现在我们默默同意不再揭伤疤。”相反，他们分享在灾难中相互依靠的记忆：水从楼上窗户泼向火焰，以及将泡沫窗封条带入室内以防止熔滴掉落到下层。张先生是旺角富苑四十多年的居民，3月在独立委员会作证。他说他爬上窗台向火焰泼水。他说他和妻子收留了一位无法逃离的年长邻居。

paragraphs.en:
They were all finally rescued five hours later. The Cheungs said they now "treasure each other even more". Gabby and Antonio returned to Wang Fuk Court again on May 23, this time with their two children, aged 7 and 11. "They need to say bye-bye as well," Gabby said, "to the house, and to their stuffed animal toys that they'll never have back."
Wong said he spends more time with his daughter nowadays and maintains a steady line of communication with her school's social worker to ensure emotional support for the seven-year-old. "Being there, that's what matters," he said.
paragraphs.cn: 他们最终在五小时后全部获救。张夫妇说他们现在“更加珍惜彼此”。加比和安东尼奥于5月23日再次返回旺角富苑，这次带着他们7岁和11岁的两个孩子。“他们也需要说再见，”加比说，“向房子，以及他们再也拿不回来的毛绒玩具。”王说他现在花更多时间陪女儿，并与学校的社工保持稳定联系，以确保为这个七岁孩子提供情感支持。“在那里，这才是重要的，”他说。

paragraphs.en: The HKSAR government has introduced a "one social worker per household" service. Around 2,000 social workers from the Social Welfare Department are available to help the fire victims handle queries on financial aid and supplies, and arrange counseling sessions. Wong said the social worker assigned to him checks in regularly, and has visited the family at their temporary home. Still, he said he feels melancholy about how the old community — his daughter's childhood playmates, his own circle of friends — has disappeared. "We can hardly meet up now," he said.
paragraphs.cn: 香港特区政府推出了“一户一社工”服务。社会福利署约2000名社工可帮助火灾受害者处理财务援助和物资的查询，并安排咨询课程。王说分配给他的社工定期检查，并已到他们临时住所拜访。尽管如此，他说他对旧社区——女儿的童年玩伴、他自己的朋友圈——已经消失感到忧郁。“我们现在几乎见不到面了，”他说。

Lau, her husband, and two sons moved three times in the month following the fire.
Despite being provided a temporary shelter by the HKSAR government, they accepted a friend's offer to live in a beauty salon, she said. However, Lau's husband was too embarrassed to linger in the salon during the day as customers streamed in.

Joe Wong, whose family of five lived in Wang Tai House in the estate, said he is now a "dislocated man". Part of his daily routine used to be walking his daughter to her primary school in Tai Po.

Multiple private charities have also been distributing funds raised in the fire's aftermath. In March, the Hong Kong Red Cross reported over HK $530 million in donations.
The Red Cross said the donations would provide urgent relief funds as well as financial and psychological support for Wang Fuk Court fire victims. They will also help fund a five-year community program, providing training in disaster preparedness and first aid.

The committee held 24 public hearings from March to early May. Three more are scheduled for Monday, Wednesday and Thursday.
Evidence at the hearings has indicated a litany of suspected human factors in the blaze. The list includes: the estate's main fire alarm being deactivated during the fire; flammable scaffolding mesh and foam panels being used for renovation work; and the maintenance project's consultant and contractors likely rigging the tendering process. Oversight of the actual on-site maintenance work barely existed, the inquiry also heard.
The committee has nine months to determine the fire's cause and recommend systemic reforms. Local authorities have already floated a raft of legislative amendments and additional fire safety-related rules to overhaul building maintenance and fire-service regulation.
Seven individuals and two companies — the contractor and engineering consultant involved in the estate's renovation work — appeared in court on June 10 to face 25 offenses including conspiracy to defraud, money laundering, attempting to pervert the course of justice, and tax evasion.
Charred memories
Displaced families from the estate's seven fire-ravaged blocks were allowed to return to the site for the first time on April 20 to retrieve what remained of their possessions.
For many, it was also an opportunity to say goodbye to the place they once called home.
Among them were Gabby and Antonio, a married couple from Wang Sun House in their 40s. Inside their apartment, the plaster on the smoke-stained walls hung like ragged sheets. The door was burned through, and building debris littered the floor.
"We braced ourselves beforehand," they said. "The stair climb, and our flat's condition, were about what we imagined."
However, there was some joy amid the ruins. Antonio retrieved one of their wedding rings from their bedroom using a metal detector.
Gabby also pulled some of her old drawings from the debris. On a yellowed sheet of paper with charred edges was written the word "Family". She plans to have the page framed and displayed once they settle into a new home.
At Wang Sun House, Lau was among the first former residents to go upstairs. Unfortunately, she said gold ingots she had in her apartment were missing. She reported the suspected theft to the police.
By May 30, a total of 142 such reports had been made by Wang Fuk Court residents, with 16 cases remaining open, Hong Kong authorities said.
A local official reported that 1,674 of the 1,736 affected households in the seven fire-hit buildings — 6,265 people, including former residents, friends and helpers — had gone upstairs during the visiting period from April 20 to May 4. Around 50 opted out after viewing photos of their flats. Fewer than 10 required separate arrangements, the official reported.
Residents of Wang Chi House — the sole block untouched by the blaze — had made two return trips by May 17.
A second round of visits to the seven fire-hit buildings ran from May 21 to 29.
'Not alone'
Months on from the inferno, Lau still gets goose bumps just talking about it.
One of her neighbors lost a child in the fire, and a playmate of Lau's child lost her mother.
George Cheung Chi-lim, aged in his 70s, and his wife suffered physical injuries and have been diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder.
Joe Wong said his seven-year-old is "a different person" now — "touchier and easily angered".
Despite the negative psychological impacts of the tragedy, the survivors China Daily spoke to all agreed they were not facing their problems alone.
Lau said she still sees her old neighbors.
"We had one good cry together," she said. "Now we silently agree not to pick the wounds anymore."
Instead, they share memories of leaning on one another amid the calamity: water poured from upstairs windows down onto the flames, and Styrofoam window seals carried inside to stop the possibility of any molten drops falling on the floors below.
Cheung, a resident of Wang Fuk Court for over four decades, testified before the independent commission in March. He spoke of climbing onto a windowsill and throwing water on the flames. He said he and his wife took in an elderly neighbor who could not flee. They were all finally rescued five hours later.
The Cheungs said they now "treasure each other even more".
Gabby and Antonio returned to Wang Fuk Court again on May 23, this time with their two children, aged 7 and 11.
"They need to say bye-bye as well," Gabby said, "to the house, and to their stuffed animal toys that they'll never have back."
Wong said he spends more time with his daughter nowadays and maintains a steady line of communication with her school's social worker to ensure emotional support for the seven-year-old. "Being there, that's what matters," he said.
The HKSAR government has introduced a "one social worker per household" service. Around 2,000 social workers from the Social Welfare Department are available to help the fire victims handle queries on financial aid and supplies, and arrange counseling sessions.
Wong said the social worker assigned to him checks in regularly, and has visited the family at their temporary home.
Still, he said he feels melancholy about how the old community — his daughter's childhood playmates, his own circle of friends — has disappeared. "We can hardly meet up now," he said.

刘女士正在倒计时到6月30日，这个截止日期为香港旺角富苑火灾的幸存者提供了在荒野中度过约七个月后潜在的新生活起点。这是受影响的公寓业主接受香港特别行政区政府对其烧毁公寓收购要约的第一个指定日期。接受信将使业主有权参加特别销售计划下的“首轮选择”新房。抽签将决定谁先选择。“抽签可能把我们带到任何地方，”刘女士说。

“尽管如此，一个属于自己的地方终究比任何租来的房间好。”刘女士刚刚完成她在旺新大厦16楼的家装修，这是该小区八座塔楼之一，11月26日大火吞噬了旺角富苑。几小时内，七座建筑起火。大火肆虐了43小时，168人在这场近八十年来香港最致命的火灾中丧生。位于大埔区、靠近香港与中国大陆边界的小区曾是超过4600名居民的家。刘女士和她的家人是近2000个流离失所的家庭之一，他们在灾难后努力重建生活。

刘女士、她的丈夫和两个儿子在火灾后的一个月内搬了三次家。尽管香港特区政府提供了临时庇护所，但他们接受了朋友的建议，住在一家美容院里，她说。然而，刘女士的丈夫白天因顾客络绎不绝而尴尬地待在美容院。他去附近的公园，从“日出坐到日落”，她说。“我为他感到非常难过，尽快找到了其他地方住，”刘女士说。

重新安置是首要关切。一些幸存的旺角富苑居民认为，即使细节不明确，前方的道路大体清晰。香港特区政府已向旺角富苑公寓业主提供每平方英尺8000港元（1020美元）或10500港元的收购价格，可以是现金或“房换房”交换券。唯一幸免于火灾的旺智大厦只有在6月30日前至少75%的业主同意收购计划时才会被纳入。收购所有八座楼的总成本估计为78亿港元，包括50亿港元的公共资金和28亿港元来自政府设立的支援基金。《中国日报》采访的一些居民将重新安置描述为“迷宫般的”和“令人迷失方向的”。

他们的问题主要涉及将提供的新住宅的大小和位置。乔·王，他的五口之家曾住在小区内的旺泰大厦，他说他现在是一个“流离失所的人”。他过去日常的一部分是送女儿去大埔的小学。现在，他彻夜难眠，担心提供的公寓是否能与他们曾经拥有的相匹配，具有可比的生活空间，以及交通和医疗便利。王说，他的担忧与许多其他前居民共享，他还希望在新家有一个社区感和完善的学校网络。

根据官方的特别销售计划，有10个开发项目正在进行中。最早的项目可能在2026年底迎接居民。最后的开发项目要到2030年或2031年才能准备好。其中项目之一是大埔的一个两期新开发项目，提供1500个单位。在最乐观的预测下，最早的入住日期预计在2029年。

政府已排除在旺角富苑原址重建的可能性，理由是技术限制和漫长的时间表。但一些居民仍希望当局可能重新考虑在原址或附近重建小区。慷慨的捐赠与调查。11月27日，火灾后的第二天，一个专门的援助基金——大埔旺角富苑支援基金——启动，初始资金来自香港特区政府的3亿港元。一天之内，来自全国各地的公众捐款又增加了5亿港元。到第三天，总额已达到12亿港元。

捐款持续涌入，到2月底，基金已达到47亿港元。当局今年早些时候透露，约98%的公众捐款金额为1万港元或更少，并补充说这些可能来自“普通人”。来自机构和公司超过100万港元的大额捐款超过700笔。根据基金官方网站，部分资金已用于13个支援项目，包括为死者家属提供的慰问和丧葬费用。资金也已分配用于流离失所居民的生活津贴、租金和搬迁补贴，以及受影响的学生、工人和外籍家庭佣工的补助和津贴。

还提供了春节慰问金。多个私人慈善机构也在分发火灾后筹集的资金。3月，香港红十字会报告超过5.3亿港元的捐款。红十字会表示，这些捐款将为旺角富苑火灾受害者提供紧急救济资金以及财务和心理支持。它们还将资助一个为期五年的社区项目，提供备灾和急救培训。

与此同时，一个独立委员会于12月成立，负责查明导致火灾及其异常迅速蔓延的根本结构缺陷。委员会从3月到5月初举行了24次公开听证会。另有三次安排在周一、周三和周四。听证会上的证据表明，火灾中存在一系列涉嫌人为因素。清单包括：小区主火警在火灾期间被关闭；用于装修工作的易燃脚手架网和泡沫板；以及维护项目的顾问和承包商可能操纵招标过程。

调查还得知，对实际现场维护工作的监督几乎不存在。委员会有九个月的时间来确定火灾原因并建议系统性改革。地方当局已提出一系列立法修正案和额外的消防安全相关规则，以彻底改革建筑维护和消防服务监管。七名个人和两家公司——参与小区装修工程的承包商和工程顾问——于6月10日出庭，面临25项指控，包括串谋诈骗、洗钱、试图妨碍司法公正和逃税。烧焦的记忆。来自小区七座被火灾摧毁的楼的流离失所家庭于4月20日首次获准返回现场，取回他们剩余的财物。

对许多人来说，这也是一个向他们曾经称之为家的地方告别的机会。其中包括加比和安东尼奥，一对来自旺新大厦的40多岁已婚夫妇。在他们的公寓内，烟熏墙壁上的灰泥像破布一样挂着。门被烧穿，建筑碎片散落在地板上。“我们事先做好了心理准备，”他们说。

“爬楼梯和我们公寓的状况，大致如我们所想象。”然而，废墟中也有一些喜悦。安东尼奥用金属探测器从卧室里找到了他们的结婚戒指之一。加比还从碎片中拉出了一些她旧画作。在一张边缘烧焦的发黄纸上写着“家庭”一词。她计划在搬进新家后把这页纸装裱起来展示。

在旺新大厦，刘女士是首批上楼的前居民之一。不幸的是，她说她公寓里的金条不见了。她向警方报告了疑似盗窃。截至5月30日，旺角富苑居民共提交了142份此类报告，其中16起案件仍在调查中，香港当局表示。一名地方官员报告说，在七座火灾建筑中的1736户受影响家庭中，有1674户——包括前居民、朋友和帮手在内的6265人——在4月20日至5月4日的参观期间上了楼。

约50人在查看公寓照片后选择退出。该官员报告说，不到10人需要单独安排。旺智大厦——唯一未受火灾影响的楼——的居民截至5月17日已进行了两次返回。对七座火灾建筑的第二次参观于5月21日至29日进行。“并不孤单”。火灾过去数月后，刘女士一谈起这件事仍然起鸡皮疙瘩。

她的一个邻居在火灾中失去了一个孩子，刘女士孩子的一个玩伴失去了母亲。70多岁的乔治·张智林和他的妻子身体受伤，并被诊断出患有创伤后应激障碍。乔·王说他七岁的孩子现在“变了一个人”——“更敏感，容易生气”。尽管悲剧带来了负面心理影响，《中国日报》采访的幸存者都同意他们并非独自面对问题。刘女士说她仍然见到她的老邻居。

“我们一起大哭了一场，”她说。“现在我们默默同意不再揭伤疤。”相反，他们分享在灾难中相互依靠的记忆：水从楼上窗户泼向火焰，以及将泡沫窗封条带入室内以防止熔滴掉落到下层。张先生是旺角富苑四十多年的居民，3月在独立委员会作证。他说他爬上窗台向火焰泼水。他说他和妻子收留了一位无法逃离的年长邻居。

他们最终在五小时后全部获救。张夫妇说他们现在“更加珍惜彼此”。加比和安东尼奥于5月23日再次返回旺角富苑，这次带着他们7岁和11岁的两个孩子。“他们也需要说再见，”加比说，“向房子，以及他们再也拿不回来的毛绒玩具。”王说他现在花更多时间陪女儿，并与学校的社工保持稳定联系，以确保为这个七岁孩子提供情感支持。“在那里，这才是重要的，”他说。

香港特区政府推出了“一户一社工”服务。社会福利署约2000名社工可帮助火灾受害者处理财务援助和物资的查询，并安排咨询课程。王说分配给他的社工定期检查，并已到他们临时住所拜访。尽管如此，他说他对旧社区——女儿的童年玩伴、他自己的朋友圈——已经消失感到忧郁。“我们现在几乎见不到面了，”他说。

paragraphs.cn: 巴基斯坦总理夏巴兹·谢里夫周四表示，美国和伊朗之间的谅解备忘录已由两国领导人电子签署，并立即生效。以下是由伊朗官方通讯社、CNN和《时代》杂志等媒体发布的14点谅解备忘录全文：1. 美利坚合众国和伊朗伊斯兰共和国及其在当前战争中的盟友，通过签署本备忘录，宣布在所有战线（包括黎巴嫩）立即永久停止军事行动，并承诺从今以后不发起任何战争或针对对方的军事行动，避免威胁或使用武力，并确保黎巴嫩的领土完整和主权。最终协议将确认在所有战线（包括黎巴嫩）永久结束战争以及本段的其他规定。2.

paragraphs.en: The United States of America and the Islamic Republic of Iran undertake to respect each other's sovereignty and territorial integrity and to refrain from {{5}} in each other's internal affairs. 3. The United States of America and the Islamic Republic of Iran commit to {{6}} and achieving the final deal in maximum 60 days, extendable with mutual consent. 4. paragraphs.en: During this period, the traffic of vessels will be in proportion to the numbers of pre-war traffic being restored by the Islamic Republic of Iran. The United States of America further undertakes to remove its forces from the {{9}} of the Islamic Republic of Iran within 30 days after the final deal. 5. Upon the signing of this MoU, the Islamic Republic of Iran will make {{10}} using its best efforts for the safe passage of commercial vessels with no charge for 60 days only from the Persian Gulf to the Sea of Oman and vice versa. The traffic of commercial vessels will immediately start, and considering the need for removing the technical and military {{11}} and {{12}} by the Islamic Republic of Iran, will be instated within 30 days.
paragraphs.cn: 在此期间，船舶通行量将按伊朗伊斯兰共和国恢复的战前通行量比例进行。美利坚合众国还承诺在最终协议达成后30天内，将其部队撤出伊朗伊斯兰共和国附近区域。5. 本备忘录签署后，伊朗伊斯兰共和国将尽最大努力安排商船安全通行，在60天内免费从波斯湾往返阿曼海。商船通行将立即开始，考虑到伊朗伊斯兰共和国需要清除技术和军事障碍及排雷，将在30天内恢复。

paragraphs.en: The Islamic Republic of Iran will conduct {{13}} with the Sultanate of Oman to define the future {{14}} and {{15}} services in the Strait of Hormuz in discussion with other Persian Gulf littoral states in line with the applicable international law and the sovereign rights of coastal states of the Strait of Hormuz. 6. The United States of America undertakes with regional partners to develop a definitive, mutually agreed plan with at least $300 billion for the {{16}} and economic development of the Islamic Republic of Iran. The mechanism for the implementation of this plan will be finalized as part of a final deal within 60 days. All required licenses, waivers and permissions needed for the relevant financial transactions will be granted by the United States of America.
paragraphs.cn: 伊朗伊斯兰共和国将与阿曼苏丹国进行对话，以根据适用的国际法和霍尔木兹海峡沿岸国的主权权利，与其他波斯湾沿岸国家协商，确定霍尔木兹海峡未来的管理和海事服务。6. 美利坚合众国承诺与地区伙伴共同制定一项明确的、双方同意的计划，至少提供3000亿美元用于伊朗伊斯兰共和国的重建和经济发展。该计划的实施机制将在60天内作为最终协议的一部分最终确定。美利坚合众国将批准所有相关金融交易所需的许可证、豁免和许可。

paragraphs.en: 7. The United States of America undertakes to terminate all types of {{17}} against the Islamic Republic of Iran, including the United Nations Security Council {{18}}, i.e. IAEA Board of Governors resolutions and all {{19}} US sanctions, primary and secondary, in an agreed-upon schedule as part of the final deal. The Islamic Republic of Iran and the United States of America acknowledge the critical importance of the sanctions-termination issue abovementioned, and expressed their intentions to immediately address these issues in the negotiations, in order to achieve mutual agreement on them. 8.
paragraphs.cn: 7. 美利坚合众国承诺按照最终协议中商定的时间表，终止对伊朗伊斯兰共和国的所有类型制裁，包括联合国安理会决议、国际原子能机构理事会决议以及所有单边美国制裁（一级和二级制裁）。伊朗伊斯兰共和国和美利坚合众国承认上述制裁终止问题的关键重要性，并表示有意在谈判中立即解决这些问题，以达成双方协议。8.

paragraphs.en: The Islamic Republic of Iran reaffirms that it shall not procure or develop nuclear weapons. The United States of America and the Islamic Republic of Iran have agreed to resolve the {{20}} of stockpiled {{21}} material, pursuant to a mechanism that will be mutually agreed upon in accordance with the schedule mentioned in Paragraph Seven, with the minimum methodology to be downblending on site under the {{22}} of the IAEA. The two parties also agreed to discuss the issue of enrichment and other mutually agreed matters related to the Islamic Republic of Iran's nuclear needs based on a satisfactory framework being agreed upon in the final deal. The final deal will confirm the provisions of this paragraph. , Updated 09:47, 18-Jun-2026Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif said on Thursday that a memorandum of understanding (MoU) between the United States and Iran has been electronically signed by the leaders of both countries and has entered into force with immediate effect.
Here is the full text of the 14-point MoU published by media outlets including Iran's official news agency IRNA, CNN and Time Magazine:
1. The United States of America and the Islamic Republic of Iran and their allies in the current war by signing this MoU, declare the immediate and permanent termination of military operations on all fronts, including in Lebanon, and undertake from now on not to initiate any war or any military operation against each other, and to refrain from the threat or use of force against each other, and ensuring the territorial integrity and sovereignty of Lebanon. Final deal will confirm the permanent termination of the war on all fronts, including in Lebanon, and other provisions of this paragraph.
2. The United States of America and the Islamic Republic of Iran undertake to respect each other's sovereignty and territorial integrity and to refrain from interfering in each other's internal affairs.
3. The United States of America and the Islamic Republic of Iran commit to negotiating and achieving the final deal in maximum 60 days, extendable with mutual consent.
4. Immediately upon the signing of this MoU, the United States of America will begin the removal of its naval blockade and any disturbances or impediments against the Islamic Republic of Iran, and will fully end the naval blockade within 30 days. During this period, the traffic of vessels will be in proportion to the numbers of pre-war traffic being restored by the Islamic Republic of Iran. The United States of America further undertakes to remove its forces from the proximity of the Islamic Republic of Iran within 30 days after the final deal.
5. Upon the signing of this MoU, the Islamic Republic of Iran will make arrangements using its best efforts for the safe passage of commercial vessels with no charge for 60 days only from the Persian Gulf to the Sea of Oman and vice versa. The traffic of commercial vessels will immediately start, and considering the need for removing the technical and military obstacles and demining by the Islamic Republic of Iran, will be instated within 30 days. The Islamic Republic of Iran will conduct dialogue with the Sultanate of Oman to define the future administration and maritime services in the Strait of Hormuz in discussion with other Persian Gulf littoral states in line with the applicable international law and the sovereign rights of coastal states of the Strait of Hormuz.
6. The United States of America undertakes with regional partners to develop a definitive, mutually agreed plan with at least $300 billion for the reconstruction and economic development of the Islamic Republic of Iran. The mechanism for the implementation of this plan will be finalized as part of a final deal within 60 days. All required licenses, waivers and permissions needed for the relevant financial transactions will be granted by the United States of America.
7. The United States of America undertakes to terminate all types of sanctions against the Islamic Republic of Iran, including the United Nations Security Council resolutions, i.e. IAEA Board of Governors resolutions and all unilateral US sanctions, primary and secondary, in an agreed-upon schedule as part of the final deal. The Islamic Republic of Iran and the United States of America acknowledge the critical importance of the sanctions-termination issue abovementioned, and expressed their intentions to immediately address these issues in the negotiations, in order to achieve mutual agreement on them.
8. The Islamic Republic of Iran reaffirms that it shall not procure or develop nuclear weapons. The United States of America and the Islamic Republic of Iran have agreed to resolve the disposition of stockpiled enriched material, pursuant to a mechanism that will be mutually agreed upon in accordance with the schedule mentioned in Paragraph Seven, with the minimum methodology to be downblending on site under the supervision of the IAEA. The two parties also agreed to discuss the issue of enrichment and other mutually agreed matters related to the Islamic Republic of Iran's nuclear needs based on a satisfactory framework being agreed upon in the final deal. The final deal will confirm the provisions of this paragraph. The United States of America and the Islamic Republic of Iran acknowledge the critical importance of the nuclear issues abovementioned and express their intention to immediately address these issues in the negotiations in order to achieve mutual agreement on them.
9. Pending the final deal, the United States of America and the Islamic Republic of Iran agree to maintain the status quo. The Islamic Republic of Iran will maintain the current status quo of its nuclear program, and the United States of America will not impose any new sanctions and will not deploy additional forces in the region.
10. The United States of America undertakes that immediately upon the signing of this MoU until the termination of sanctions, the US Department of Treasury will issue waivers for the export of Iranian crude oil, petroleum products and derivatives, and all associated services, including banking transactions, insurances, transportation, etc.
11. The United States of America undertakes to make fully available for use the frozen or restricted funds and assets of the Islamic Republic of Iran upon the implementation of this MoU. The United States of America and the Islamic Republic of Iran will mutually agree on the procedures related to the release of these funds during the negotiations. Such funds, either retained in the original account or transferred, shall be made fully usable for payment to any ultimate beneficiary designated by the Central Bank of the Islamic Republic of Iran. The United States of America undertakes to issue all necessary licenses and authorizations accordingly.
12. The United States of America and the Islamic Republic of Iran agree that an executive mechanism will be established to monitor the successful implementation of this MoU and the future compliance of the final deal.
13. After signing this MoU and subject to the beginning of the implementation of Paragraphs 1, 4, 5, 10 and 11 of this MoU and the continuing implementation of these measures, the United States of America and the Islamic Republic of Iran will start negotiations regarding the final deal exclusively on the other paragraphs.

articles.title: 5G tech transforms factory in Zhejiang province
articles.summary: The first commercial 5G local area network in Zhejiang province has successfully transformed the China Jushi fiberglass factory into a highly efficient, unmanned smart manufacturing hub.
articles.summaryCn: 浙江首个商用5G局域网成功将中国巨石玻璃纤维工厂转型为高效无人智能制造中心，大幅提升生产效率。

paragraphs.en: The first commercial 5G local area network in Zhejiang province has successfully transformed the China Jushi fiberglass factory into a highly efficient, {{1}} smart manufacturing {{2}}. On the intelligent production lines of China Jushi Co, a seamless dance of human-machine {{3}} is unfolding. As the building materials industry {{4}} its {{5}} from traditional manufacturing to smart manufacturing, fiberglass — a critical material for wind power, new energy vehicles and 5G communications — has become a focal point for technological {{6}}. China Jushi, a core enterprise of China National Building Material Co Ltd, stands as a global leader in the fiberglass industry. The company boasts the world's largest production {{7}}, holding a {{8}} 40 percent market share in China and 24 percent globally.
paragraphs.cn: 浙江省首个商用5G局域网成功将中国巨石玻璃纤维工厂转型为高效、无人化的智能制造中心。在中国巨石股份有限公司的智能生产线上，人机协作的无缝舞蹈正在展开。随着建材行业加速从传统制造向智能制造转型，玻璃纤维——作为风电、新能源汽车和5G通信的关键材料——已成为技术突破的焦点。中国巨石是中国建材集团的核心企业，是全球玻璃纤维行业的领导者。该公司拥有全球最大的生产能力，在中国市场占据40%的份额，在全球市场占据24%的份额。

paragraphs.en: Over the years, China Jushi has maintained its industry-leading position in scale, technology and quality, earning {{9}} {{10}} such as the China Grand Awards for Industry, the National Science and Technology Progress Award, and recognition as a national intelligent manufacturing demonstration factory. To further accelerate its digital transformation, China Unicom Zhejiang Branch recently achieved the deep commercial {{11}} of a 5G LAN at China Jushi's No 5 factory in Jiaxing, Zhejiang. This {{12}} project marks the very first commercial use case of 5G LAN in Zhejiang, helping Jushi build a {{13}} 5G-powered factory. The advanced 5G LAN technology supports 5G-native Layer 2 networking, allowing terminals to be highly flexible and plug-and-play. Crucially, it maintains the enterprise's original network {{14}}, significantly lowering the difficulty of upgrading production lines to 5G.
paragraphs.cn: 多年来，中国巨石在规模、技术和质量方面保持了行业领先地位，荣获了中国工业大奖、国家科技进步奖等殊荣，并被认定为国家级智能制造示范工厂。为进一步加速数字化转型，中国联通浙江省分公司最近在中国巨石位于浙江嘉兴的五号工厂实现了5G局域网的深度商业集成。这一里程碑项目标志着浙江省首个5G局域网商业应用案例，帮助巨石建设了全面的5G工厂。先进的5G局域网技术支持5G原生二层网络，使终端具有高度灵活性和即插即用功能。关键的是，它保留了企业原有的网络架构，显著降低了生产线升级到5G的难度。

paragraphs.en: The technology can create specialized "groups" for enterprise terminals at Layer 2 or Layer 3, providing flexible communication services such as terminal {{15}} and {{16}}. At the Jiaxing No 5 factory, 5G terminals are installed directly into control cabinets, deeply integrating with the factory's programmable logic controllers — the "brains" of the machinery. By utilizing advanced 5G LAN technology, the factory has constructed a seamless end-to-end network. This enables real-time collaboration between different programmable logic controllers and ensures instant data sharing with the supervisory control and data acquisition system. This signifies a major step forward for China Unicom's 5G Private Network Plus 3.0, proving that 5G has deeply {{18}} the core production links of industrial manufacturing.
paragraphs.cn: 该技术可以在二层或三层为企业终端创建专门的“组”，提供终端互联和隔离等灵活通信服务。在嘉兴五号工厂，5G终端直接安装在控制柜中，与工厂的可编程逻辑控制器（机器的“大脑”）深度集成。通过利用先进的5G局域网技术，工厂构建了无缝的端到端网络。这实现了不同可编程逻辑控制器之间的实时协作，并确保与监控和数据采集系统的即时数据共享。这标志着中国联通5G专网Plus 3.0迈出了重要一步，证明了5G已深入渗透到工业制造的核心生产环节。

paragraphs.en: Stepping into the No 5 factory, the results are visually {{19}}. Industrial robots navigate the workshop in perfect order, executing material transport and loading with flawless {{20}}. Rows of mechanical arms complete complex procedures with every bend and stretch, while rolls of fiberglass packaging materials are automatically elevated within the smart warehouse. Only a handful of technicians are needed to {{21}} products or machinery. In the factory's intelligent control center, massive display screens continuously update dense data charts, providing a digitized, visualized and full-process {{22}} system for multiple production lines.
paragraphs.cn: 走进五号工厂，成果令人瞩目。工业机器人在车间内有序穿梭，以完美的精度执行物料运输和装载。一排排机械臂通过每一次弯曲和伸展完成复杂工序，而一卷卷玻璃纤维包装材料在智能仓库中自动升降。只有少数技术人员需要对产品或机器进行调试。在工厂的智能控制中心，巨大的显示屏不断更新密集的数据图表，为多条生产线提供数字化、可视化和全流程监控系统。

paragraphs.en:
Song Guangmin, director of the industrial internet support center at China Unicom Zhejiang Branch, highlighted the philosophy behind this transformation. "From the very beginning of the factory's construction, we established a foundational requirement for the full connection of data elements," Song said. "What we see now is a 'mega-factory' in Zhejiang — a fully connected operation based on the deep integration of 5G, IT and operational technologies."
Song noted that the factory leverages AI large models for extensive data collection, analysis and scenario applications. "The massive unmanned technologies operating here are the result of fusing new-generation information technologies, represented by 5G, with AI large models. This has dramatically boosted China Jushi's {{23}}, increasing its production efficiency by over 20 percent since the project was {{24}}," he said.
paragraphs.cn: 中国联通浙江省分公司工业互联网支撑中心主任宋广民强调了这一转型背后的理念。“从工厂建设之初，我们就确立了数据要素全面连接的基础要求，”宋广民说。“我们现在看到的是浙江的一个‘超级工厂’——基于5G、IT和运营技术深度融合的全面连接运营。”宋广民指出，该工厂利用AI大模型进行广泛的数据收集、分析和场景应用。“这里运行的大规模无人技术是5G为代表的新一代信息技术与AI大模型融合的结果。这极大地提升了中国巨石的竞争力，自项目实施以来，其生产效率提高了20%以上，”他说。

paragraphs.en: The customized computing power required for these AI applications is seamlessly provided by China Unicom's supercomputing center in Wuzhen, Zhejiang. During a recent visit, Fan Ji'an, chief big data scientist at China Unicom, highly praised the deep integration of the 5G factory. China Unicom and Jushi have agreed to expand their cooperation in industrial manufacturing, including reliability verification of cross-SMF 5G LAN networking, extending 5G LAN to multi-campus wide-area networks and building 5G private networks for China Jushi's new factories. Based on China Unicom's unified multi-campus 5G private network solution, we aim to connect upstream and downstream industries, establish a wide-area 5G LAN, and promote our advanced fiberglass production technologies from the Tongxiang headquarters to global branches in Chengdu, Sichuan province, Jiujiang, Jiangxi province, and Suez in Egypt, leading the high-quality development of the global fiberglass industry."

The first commercial 5G local area network in Zhejiang province has successfully transformed the China Jushi fiberglass factory into a highly efficient, unmanned smart manufacturing hub.
On the intelligent production lines of China Jushi Co, a seamless dance of human-machine collaboration is unfolding. As the building materials industry accelerates its transition from traditional manufacturing to smart manufacturing, fiberglass — a critical material for wind power, new energy vehicles and 5G communications — has become a focal point for technological breakthroughs.
China Jushi, a core enterprise of China National Building Material Co Ltd, stands as a global leader in the fiberglass industry. The company boasts the world's largest production capacity, holding a commanding 40 percent market share in China and 24 percent globally. Over the years, China Jushi has maintained its industry-leading position in scale, technology and quality, earning prestigious accolades such as the China Grand Awards for Industry, the National Science and Technology Progress Award, and recognition as a national intelligent manufacturing demonstration factory.
To further accelerate its digital transformation, China Unicom Zhejiang Branch recently achieved the deep commercial integration of a 5G LAN at China Jushi's No 5 factory in Jiaxing, Zhejiang. This milestone project marks the very first commercial use case of 5G LAN in Zhejiang, helping Jushi build a comprehensive 5G-powered factory.
The advanced 5G LAN technology supports 5G-native Layer 2 networking, allowing terminals to be highly flexible and plug-and-play. Crucially, it maintains the enterprise's original network architecture, significantly lowering the difficulty of upgrading production lines to 5G. The technology can create specialized "groups" for enterprise terminals at Layer 2 or Layer 3, providing flexible communication services such as terminal interconnection and isolation.
At the Jiaxing No 5 factory, 5G terminals are installed directly into control cabinets, deeply integrating with the factory's programmable logic controllers — the "brains" of the machinery. By utilizing advanced 5G LAN technology, the factory has constructed a seamless end-to-end network. This enables real-time collaboration between different programmable logic controllers and ensures instant data sharing with the supervisory control and data acquisition system. This signifies a major step forward for China Unicom's 5G Private Network Plus 3.0, proving that 5G has deeply penetrated the core production links of industrial manufacturing.
Stepping into the No 5 factory, the results are visually striking. Industrial robots navigate the workshop in perfect order, executing material transport and loading with flawless precision. Rows of mechanical arms complete complex procedures with every bend and stretch, while rolls of fiberglass packaging materials are automatically elevated within the smart warehouse. Only a handful of technicians are needed to debug products or machinery. In the factory's intelligent control center, massive display screens continuously update dense data charts, providing a digitized, visualized and full-process monitoring system for multiple production lines.
Song Guangmin, director of the industrial internet support center at China Unicom Zhejiang Branch, highlighted the philosophy behind this transformation. "From the very beginning of the factory's construction, we established a foundational requirement for the full connection of data elements," Song said. "What we see now is a 'mega-factory' in Zhejiang — a fully connected operation based on the deep integration of 5G, IT and operational technologies."

"The massive unmanned technologies operating here are the result of fusing new-generation information technologies, represented by 5G, with AI large models. This has dramatically boosted China Jushi's competitiveness, increasing its production efficiency by over 20 percent since the project was implemented," he said. The customized computing power required for these AI applications is seamlessly provided by China Unicom's supercomputing center in Wuzhen, Zhejiang.
During a recent visit, Fan Ji'an, chief big data scientist at China Unicom, highly praised the deep integration of the 5G factory. China Unicom and Jushi have agreed to expand their cooperation in industrial manufacturing, including reliability verification of cross-SMF 5G LAN networking, extending 5G LAN to multi-campus wide-area networks and building 5G private networks for China Jushi's new factories.
Yu Yadong, director of the information technology center at China Jushi, outlined the ambitious road ahead: "The 5G factory will not only focus on internal digital and intelligent transformation, but also expand externally. Based on China Unicom's unified multi-campus 5G private network solution, we aim to connect upstream and downstream industries, establish a wide-area 5G LAN, and promote our advanced fiberglass production technologies from the Tongxiang headquarters to global branches in Chengdu, Sichuan province, Jiujiang, Jiangxi province, and Suez in Egypt, leading the high-quality development of the global fiberglass industry."

在中国东北港口城市大连的会议场馆外，一排排流线型电动汽车安静地穿行于街道，自动驾驶巴士在指定站点间穿梭，氢动力客车已准备就绪，接送前来参加2026年夏季达沃斯论坛的代表们。这不仅是物流展示，更让人们初步窥见今年会议的核心议题：在日益不确定的全球经济中，技术创新、绿色转型和国际合作。这场正式名称为世界经济论坛“新领军者年会”的活动，定于周二至周四举行，预计将汇聚来自90多个国家和地区的1700多名参与者，共同探讨世界如何应对全球挑战，同时创造新的增长机遇。今年会议的主题是“大规模创新”，将围绕中国经济发展下一阶段以及如何将技术进步转化为实际经济效益等议题展开讨论。这两个问题在论坛议程中占据突出位置，人工智能和机器人技术贯穿始终。

将组织一场专门会议，讨论中国一些最热门的科技趋势，包括个人AI代理的建立和训练、一人公司的兴起，以及人形机器人在工厂中的日益普及。中国人工智能产业的快速扩张推动了人们对这些话题的兴趣。2025年，中国人工智能企业数量超过6000家，核心人工智能产业估值预计超过1.2万亿元人民币（约合1761亿美元）。根据经合组织的统计数据，2025年，中国人工智能公司吸引了约139亿美元的全球风险投资，位居世界第三。然而，讨论不仅限于技术机遇。在往年讨论的基础上，本次会议还将更深入地探讨人工智能带来的挑战，包括技术获取不平等、隐私和安全问题以及信息过载。除了创新，绿色发展是今年论坛的另一个关键词。这一承诺贯穿论坛的运营始终。

新能源汽车将占论坛交通车队的80%以上，而主会场大连国际会议中心将完全使用绿色电力。其空调系统还将采用海水源热泵技术，帮助降低能耗超过30%。大连市市长李强表示：“所有这些努力充分展示了大连在举办此次活动时，致力于采用清洁、节能和资源循环利用的方式。”这些原则的应用也体现在主办城市的产业转型中。利用其独特的沿海地理优势，大连一直在稳步扩大其清洁能源产业链。

在氢气生产、储存和运输、燃料电池以及氢能应用领域，该市现已拥有50多家企业和研究机构，形成了相对完整的产业链。通过在全球对话中分享这些经验，论坛旨在实现更广泛的目标——促进各国如何应对日益复杂世界的对话。世界经济论坛总裁兼首席执行官阿洛伊斯·茨温吉表示：“世界经济论坛始终将领导者们聚集在一起，应对影响世界的最大挑战，并通过对话与合作寻找解决方案。在经济不确定性、地缘政治紧张和技术快速变革的时代，本次会议是一个关注切实解决方案的机会。”中国的经验和解决方案将继续成为焦点，因为合作伙伴对深化与中国的合作表现出越来越浓厚的兴趣。这种兴趣体现在持续的外国投资上。

2025年，超过8000家外资企业增加了对华投资，同比增长超过10%。根据商务部5月份的数据，今年1月至4月，又有3000多家外资企业在中国追加了投资。随着中国表示愿意继续与全球共享发展机遇，其下一阶段的发展预计将与全球增长紧密相连。今年3月，中国发布了第十五个五年规划（2026-2030年）。国家发展和改革委员会官员高伟奇表示，这一蓝图不仅规划了中国自身的发展道路，也强调了其继续为全球增长做出贡献的承诺，这已经产生了显著的溢出效应。

高伟奇说：“中国健康稳定的发展将为世界经济注入更大的确定性和新动力。”夏季达沃斯论坛由世界经济论坛于2007年创立，每年在中国举办，轮流在天津和大连两个港口城市举行。

In March, Qiushi Journal published an article by Chinese President Xi Jinping on promoting the high-quality development of the marine economy. The article stressed the need to efficiently utilize marine resources, advance marine science and technology, and "forge a Chinese path of leveraging marine resources to achieve strength" while balancing development and environmental protection.
China's gross ocean product reached 11.02 trillion yuan (about $1.6 trillion) in 2025, accounting for 7.9% of the country's GDP, according to data by the Ministry of Natural Resources.
Green marine industries have also continued to expand.
China's newly connected offshore wind power capacity grew by more than 60% year on year in 2025, highlighting the role of clean energy in the country's marine economic transformation.
Three large cruise ships are docked at the Wusongkou International Cruise Terminal in Shanghai, east China, June 24, 2025. 
Growth in the marine economy is also being driven by the recovery of ocean-related services.
In 2025, the added value of China's marine tourism industry exceeded 1.6 trillion yuan, up 5.9% year on year. Cruise passenger traffic increased by 25.3%, highlighting the vitality of coastal tourism and ocean-based consumption.
The deep-sea manned submersible Fendouzhe, in Sanya, Hainan Province, south China, December 5, 2021. 
That momentum was evident at OCEANS 2026 Sanya, held in south China's Hainan Province in May.
The conference gathered more than 700 scientists, engineers and young scholars from 26 countries and regions. More than 400 technical papers explored topics ranging from deep-sea exploration to underwater sensor networks and marine energy.
The conference also highlighted Hainan's progress in deep-sea equipment, marine communications, offshore aquaculture and ecological conservation.

International cooperation has also become an important part of ocean science.
In Sanya, the fourth workshop organized by the International Seabed Authority-China Joint Training and Research Centre gathered participants from developing countries across Africa, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and the Caribbean.
Since its establishment in 2020, the center has trained 120 specialists from more than 40 countries in deep-sea science, marine spatial planning and environmental management, reflecting China's continued engagement in global ocean governance and capacity building.

As marine technologies move from laboratories into industrial applications, offshore aquaculture is becoming a key pillar of China's "Blue Granary" initiative. Near Guangdong's Guishan Island, the Gesheng No. 1 platform has expanded its farming capacity to 30,000 cubic meters while requiring only three staff members for daily operations.
Intelligent sonar systems, automated feeding and environmental data models have helped achieve survival rates of more than 98% for newly stocked fish.
Meanwhile, Suhai-1, the world's first roving salmon and trout aquaculture vessel, is capable of producing up to 8,000 tonnes of premium salmon annually, demonstrating new possibilities for intelligent offshore farming.
The Huadian Yuhuan No. 1 offshore windfarm in Taizhou, Zhejiang Province, east China, October 8, 2025. 
The theme of World Oceans Day 2026 encourages people to rethink their relationship with the ocean, not only as a source of resources but also as a vital ecosystem linked to humanity's future.
Efforts in marine technology, offshore development and international cooperation are showing how China is pursuing more sustainable use of ocean resources.
As new innovations continue to move from research into real-world applications, opportunities are expanding to advance marine economic growth while supporting long-term environmental stewardship.
